author: SnowSX3
body:
Leaving the thread open for other questions doesn't do anything because only seniors can comment on this subforum.
Players can't reply...which is a strange feature to this subforum. It's not really a forum is people can discuss on it..

Hence the creation of a completely new thread simply to continue discussion...


I understand he has the ability to develop the TeamSpeak server, but I don't believe he deserves his position and want some feedback/explanation from the higher ups.

Zac's not exactly what most people would consider mature.
He has a lot of maturity and behavioural issues and as a result, has had run ins with multiple players and staff.
He's also has multiple infractions and has been banned numerous times.

He's directly and indirectly insulted many people In front of and behind their backs.
How is this person developing TeamSpeak?

He would never be promoted for a moderator position so why is he a developer?
It's such a high position..I just don't understand.

Now, I understand that TeamSpeak and the server/forums are two different platforms with different standards but how can someone so toxic be promoted to develop the ts server?

Yes, he may be capable.
But being able to do something and deserving to do something are two completely different things.

I guess my question is despite all of his behavioural issues, how did the seniors look past that to promote him?

I do not want him developing Teamspeak, not because I don't think he is able to, but because I don't think he is deserving of the position. 

I guess Ill have to make a third thread to respond soo..looking forward to that.

Keep in mind that I don't personally have an issue with anyone.
I just take pride in this server and want to see it progress.
Even if I have to be a bit blunt with feedback and questions.

Chur bros.

replies.body:
I guess my question is despite all of his behavioural issues, how did the seniors look past that to promote him?
We looked at what the promotion would do overall and the consequences of not promoting him. It's better this way then him being banned and us having to sort issues out 24/7 because i would much rather work on things that matter than small issues that keep building up.
